title: BRE Group
content:
BRE Group is the UK's leading building science organisation, tracing its history to the Building Research Station of 1921 and headquartered in Watford, England. Owned by the BRE Trust charity, it provides research, testing, certification and standards services covering building performance, fire safety, energy and sustainability, including the BREEAM sustainability assessment method and LPCB loss-prevention certification.

Through its laboratories, BRE evaluates construction and insulation products against UK, European and international standards. For aerogel and insulation buyers and specifiers, its value lies in independent, science-based testing and third-party certification of thermal performance, fire behaviour and durability for construction markets.
excerpt: UK building science centre offering independent testing and certification (BREEAM, LPCB) for construction and insulation materials.
